technique_name: Generate a 10-sentence narrative based on the following prompt.
description:
It was the start of the school year, but nothing felt normal. Everyone was required to wear masks in the hallways, and the new student felt out of place as she walked down the empty corridor. She was the only new student in the school, and she had arrived late due to the pandemic. 

The student timidly opened the door to her first class and was relieved to see the other students were wearing masks as well. Everyone looked up as she entered and gave her a welcome nod. She found a seat in the back
example: A new student arrives at school during a pandemic.
